scale.interpretation: Rating is a person's editorial judgement; software must not infer it from readability.

anchors.0: Invents personal history, quote or major factual claim
anchors.2: Mostly grounded but meaningful uncertainty or ownership slips
anchors.4: Every material claim is grounded, scoped and attributed fairly

anchors.1: Often assumes wrong context or relation
anchors.2: Some useful fit with regular mismatches
anchors.4: Natural attention to reader's knowledge and needs throughout

anchors.0: Generic, obviously scripted or alien to writer
anchors.2: Mixed; human moments but repeated staged lines
anchors.3: Generally sounds like what the writer might say, with few stiff passages
anchors.4: Sounds naturally like the writer across beginning, middle and end, not a copied verbal formula

anchors.1: Repeats slogans or takes unexplained leaps
anchors.2: Partial argument with thin sections or missing objections
anchors.3: Reasons, consequences and limits developed with few gaps
anchors.4: Sustained, layered logic that earns its conclusion and respects real objections

anchors.2: Understandable but technical/vague sections need decoding
anchors.3: Clear with accurate explanations for most hard terms
anchors.4: Reader can paraphrase arguments and needed concepts correctly without strain

anchors.0: Invents feelings, private memories or manipulates reader
anchors.1: Frequent unearned emotion or false intimacy
anchors.2: Some care but generic or overly certain feelings
anchors.3: Emotion is precise and backed by situation, with rare weak lines
anchors.4: Emotion arises naturally from supported facts and real limits, with no borrowed testimony

anchors.2: Uneven mix of real detail and vague padding
anchors.3: Most examples do explanatory work and are labelled
anchors.4: Each substantial example is grounded, relevant and shows a consequence

anchors.3: Sections build logically with a few weak transitions
anchors.4: Every section moves the full argument forward, without reintroducing the thesis

anchors.0: Mechanical fragments or exhausting density throughout
anchors.1: Many hurried, repetitive or padded passages
anchors.2: Noticeable uneven pace, thin or overlong sections
anchors.3: Mostly comfortable spoken pace, varied by idea
anchors.4: Patient, human pacing sustained through the whole essay

anchors.0: Regular fabricated drama and clichéd flips
anchors.3: Mostly avoids forced formulas, minor lapses
anchors.4: Natural and unforced throughout, including endings

anchors.0: False or harmful claim, no valid finish
anchors.1: Generic compulsory lesson or false certainty
anchors.4: Quiet, precise conclusion that closes the argument naturally

anchors.1: Often written like a script or short post
anchors.2: Some essay depth but substantial genre mismatches
anchors.4: Meets long-form reader purpose without a template

anchors.0: Frequent unclear, unnatural or misleading sentences
anchors.1: Many vague, stiff, redundant or awkward sentences
anchors.2: Mixed sentence quality with recurring problems
anchors.3: Most sentences serve their paragraph; a few need work
anchors.4: Ordinary, precise and speakable sentence craft across beginning, middle and end

sentence_audit.quota_justification: Full sentence-by-sentence review for every 2000-word draft would be costly. Audit stratified 30 sentences for every candidate, all automatically flagged risk cases, and every sentence for the final two shortlisted versions.

truth_gate.policy: Any positive blocking flag or verified=false yields NO VALID SCORE until reviewed; no compensating style score.

length_diagnostics.flesch_target_advisory: 85-93 for appropriate accessible reflection; never target by deleting necessary doctrine or facts.
length_diagnostics.baseline_note: Divine Design long essay: 66.3 FRE, grade 7.3, 3052 words, avg sentence 13.4. Refined approved short advice: 93.0 FRE, grade 3.6, 361 words, avg sentence 13.4. Different texts, not a version causal estimate.
